p: Stockwell Gate runs into the Market Place, the centre of Mansfield town, so this MERKUR is right among the shops and handy for the bus station. The Robin Hood Line railway brings you in from Nottingham, and the town's big brick railway viaduct striding over the centre is hard to miss. This is an 18+ venue.

There's plenty to do while you're here. Mansfield Museum, close to the town centre, covers local history and wildlife. The Palace Theatre puts on shows, pantos and tribute nights. And Sherwood Forest is on the doorstep: drive out to Edwinstowe to see the Major Oak, the giant old tree said to have sheltered Robin Hood, or head to Sherwood Pines for walking, cycling and Go Ape. Mansfield Town play just outside the centre at Field Mill if you're after a match.
